notes.content: All courses submitted towards either major or minor requirements in the Computer Science Department must be taken for a letter grade (A-F). This includes electives in CS and all other courses taken to satisfy the major. Only those classes for which a student has received a C- or better may be used to satisfy prerequisite requirements.
